description: TDX: An R Package for Transport Data Access is a software deposit deposited in Zenodo by its authors Chia-Jung Yeh (University of Sydney). This package provides a practical and efficient framework for integrating transport and sociodemographic data into a unified workflow. By streamlining the process of linking these datasets, it reduces the effort required for data preparation and enables researchers to focus on analysis, not data management. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
